related_resources.reason: Reviews technical and social operation of small tank cascades, local water governance and archaeological chronology, including distinctions between claims and demonstrated dates.
An audit of 837 deduplicated irrigation references from inscriptions and chronicles, covering reservoirs, grants, incomes, and public works; records heavily favor Anuradhapura and specific centuries.
Stratigraphic and luminescence chronology of tank construction and silting: some features predate or outlast changes in political capital.
Supplementary article for orientation only; no historical claim relies on this source.
